messages:
rachel: heads-up — pipeline and a person both touched the edge-cache flag this morning. console showed the human's 70% but webhooks and audit only referenced the pipeline's 30% change.
diego: ouch. sequence? PUT vs PATCH?
rachel: pipeline used PATCH; console save does a PUT which replaced the audit blob and cleared per-field provenance.
sophie: that audit-as-single-blob is the root cause. we need per-field change entries or at least change-sets per write.
kevin: concrete API pattern: require version/ETag for strong writes. PATCH stays merge-friendly. If both current and incoming differ from base -> return 409 with changed_fields and a tiny diff payload. also support ?preview=true for dry-run.
rachel: console UX: before a destructive PUT, do a quick GET and show a banner: "Changed 18s ago by automation — your save will overwrite. [View diff] [Merge] [Cancel]". let users preview route/quota impact.
sophie: operationally, if a manual override increases scope >10% surface a canary workflow suggestion (5% -> 25% -> full) and list impacted routes + estimated token delta.
ops-bot: ALERT: flag-collision-surge 2026-03-18T11:02Z  10 events from service-pipeline.
diego: telemetry: add origin tag (automation|service-account|user:id) and record dry-run preview events so we can see how often people check before committing.
kevin: server impl idea: three-way merge (base, incoming, current). if both diverge return 409 {current_version, base_version, diff, changed_fields}. if only incoming differs accept and bump version.
sophie: i'd prefer append-only changelog + periodic snapshots. makes diffs trivial and gives per-field history. reads use latest snapshot + tail.
rachel: webhooks should include quota_hint: {impacted_routes:[...], est_token_delta: "+12%"} so quota routers can prewarm or throttle.
kevin: emergency override: allow force=true but require approver and 2FA for prod flags; log approver and reason.
sophie: tests: add integration that simulates 200 concurrent PATCH/PUT races and assert changelog contains separate entries for automation and manual edits and that conflicts return 409 with diff.
diego: add small console list badges [auto-change] [manual-edit] [previewed] with hover showing last 3 changes to reduce surprise.
rachel: i'll open PRs: api 3-way merge + 409 schema; console preview + diff modal; telemetry dry-run bucket; webhook quota hints. staging deploy tomorrow AM.
kevin: i'll own server piece and tests. sophie takes changelog/snapshot design. diego does telemetry + hooks.
ops-bot: REMINDER: add #flags-collisions to oncall playbook and schedule a canary of the new preview endpoint to staging 2026-03-19T02:00-03:00 UTC.
